hiringProcess._note: ONE source for the hiring process. Both /careers/ (careersPageUses) and every role page (rolePagesUse) render from here. The two variants below are the two stories that were live on the site; the owner has not yet said which is true. When they do, set both pointers to the same key (and edit that variant) so the two places say the same thing. A role may still override with its own hiringSteps array.

conversation.faq: Four steps: your CV and a short note, a conversation with whoever runs the discipline, one paid piece of real work scoped to a day, and a meeting with the rest of the team before anyone decides.

steps.d: Apply with your CV (file or link) plus a short note: what you would own, what you would change in the first ninety days, and what you need from us.
A call with whoever runs the discipline. Mostly you asking us things.
One paid piece of actual work from a live account, scoped to a day. We pay for it either way.
You meet everyone before anyone decides.
30-minute screening call with the Head of Performance
A 90-minute case study you complete on your own time
Final round, a 2-hour panel with founders and the team you'd work with
Reference checks and an offer within 7 days

roles.title: Senior Meta Buyer
roles.hint: Run Meta for D2C accounts, with creative as the lever.
roles.summary: You will own daily operations on our biggest Meta accounts for D2C brands, work closely with the creative team and report to founders every week. You are the senior we do not have to manage.
responsibilities: Own the full Meta account architecture across D2C accounts
Daily campaign optimisation, weekly cohort reviews and monthly reporting
Work with the creative team on the volume of creative each brand needs
Server-side CAPI implementation and measurement triangulation
Mentor mid-level buyers and review their work weekly
Run the brief on quarterly strategy resets
youAre: 5 to 9 years running Meta at brands or agencies, D2C preferred
Comfortable owning a P&L and explaining it to founders
You treat creative as the lever, not the bottleneck
You read data daily, optimise weekly and never overreact
bonus: Cohort modelling tools such as Triple Whale or Northbeam

screening.q: Walk us through the largest Meta account you've personally managed.
Describe a creative test that meaningfully moved CPM or hook rate.
screening.hint: What changed, what you measured, what you learned.

screening.q: How do you split BAU optimisation vs. weekly creative refresh?
screening.hint: Cadence, decision rules, who you collaborate with.

screening.q: A brand of yours just blew through the daily budget on a single campaign. First three things you do.

roles.title: Google + Amazon Specialist
roles.hint: Search, Performance Max and Amazon Ads as one connected stack.
roles.summary: Run Google and Amazon as one connected stack for our D2C brands: Search, Performance Max, Shopping and Demand Gen on Google, Sponsored Products and DSP on Amazon.
responsibilities: Daily campaign management across Google and Amazon
Performance Max structure, asset feeds and budget allocation
Amazon Ads strategy across Sponsored Products, Brands, Display and DSP
Cross-channel reporting and attribution triangulation
Weekly creative briefs to the studio
youAre: 4 to 7 years running Google and Amazon Ads at agencies or brands
Amazon Ads experience across India and the US is a strong plus

screening.q: Describe your most successful PMax structure to date.
screening.hint: Asset groups, audience signals, exclusions, outcome.

screening.q: How do you decide between Sponsored Products vs. Sponsored Brand budget on Amazon?
Walk us through cross-channel attribution between Google Ads and Amazon for a multi-marketplace brand.
How would you triage a brand whose Google CAC has doubled in a quarter?

roles.title: Senior Art Director
roles.hint: Lead brand identity and performance creative across the D2C book.
roles.summary: Direct identity systems, packaging and performance creative for our brands. You own visual standards across every touchpoint.
responsibilities: Brand identity rebuilds and design systems
Direct UGC, motion and static creative for performance
Packaging direction with manufacturing partners
Mentor mid-level designers
youAre: 6+ years in brand or D2C creative
A portfolio with shipped identity systems
Comfortable directing photo and video shoots

screening.q: Walk us through a brand identity system you've shipped end to end.
screening.hint: From positioning to packaging to performance creative.

screening.q: How do you direct a UGC shoot for a brand the audience has never heard of?
Describe the brief you'd write for a 60-asset performance creative sprint.
Pick one of your projects and explain a design choice that was hard to defend.

roles.title: Performance Copywriter
roles.hint: Hooks, scripts, landing pages and lifecycle copy.
roles.summary: Write the words that move the maths: ad scripts, hooks, landing-page copy and email flows for D2C brands.
responsibilities: Write hooks and scripts for UGC and direct response
Build landing-page copy systems
Write email and WhatsApp lifecycle copy
Pair daily with art directors and buyers
youAre: You have published your own writing
You speak both brand and performance

screening.q: Paste the best three-second hook you've written, then tell us why it worked.
screening.hint: Brand, format, the data you saw.

screening.q: How do you write copy differently for cold acquisition vs. warm retention?
Describe your weekly volume cadence on your last role.
screening.hint: Scripts, headlines, emails, with realistic numbers.

screening.q: A founder pushes back on copy you believe in. How do you respond?
screening.hint: What you ask, what you concede, what you hold.

roles.title: Growth Strategist, D2C
roles.hint: Own a P&L, lead a pod and run quarterly strategy.
roles.summary: You own D2C accounts end to end: strategy, P&L, the pod around each account and the founder relationship. The senior we trust with the brand.
responsibilities: P&L ownership across your D2C accounts
Lead the pod: buyer, creative, retention and tech
Weekly founder calls and quarterly reviews
Drive the 90-day roadmap on each account
youAre: 5 to 9 years in growth strategy, or as a founder
You read a P&L the way most people read a tweet
You can write a one-page thesis without a deck

screening.q: Walk us through a P&L you've owned and the levers you pulled.
Write the one-page growth thesis you'd hand a founder on day one.
Describe the pod structure you'd build around a large annual retainer.
Tell us about a brand you said no to, or would say no to. Why.

roles.title: Shopify Plus Engineer
roles.hint: Shopify Plus and headless. Speed, AOV, retention.
roles.summary: Run Shopify Plus engineering for our D2C brands: theme architecture, headless storefronts, app integrations and speed.
responsibilities: Theme and headless storefront builds
Speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
Klaviyo, Razorpay and GA4 integrations
Liquid, React and JavaScript
youAre: You have shipped headless on a real brand

screening.q: Describe the largest Shopify Plus build you've shipped.
How do you approach LCP and Core Web Vitals on a heavy product page?
Walk us through a headless migration you've led.
screening.hint: Why headless, what broke, what you'd do differently.

screening.q: Show us a piece of Liquid or JS you're proud of.
screening.hint: Paste or link. Tell us why.
